english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something following the rules or pattern, or for someone feeling usual and well again.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that is functioning properly.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for something normal or expected.
Use this when ordinary means normal or as expected rather than merely unremarkable.
Use this when “regular” means that bowel movements or menstrual periods are normal and occur as expected.
